source_lines.41: normal-sequence suppliers. For a closed immersion $i:X\hookrightarrow Y$ with
source_lines.45: $B=\operatorname{Bl}_XY$ be the strict transform of $Y\times\{\infty\}$. The
source_lines.46: fibre at infinity is the sum $M_\infty=B+\mathbb P(C_XY\oplus1)$ of effective
source_lines.47: Cartier divisors, whose intersection is $\mathbb P(C_XY)$; this is a union with
source_lines.48: a common boundary, not a disjoint union. Projectivized cones here use the lines
source_lines.50: Off infinity $M\cong Y\times\mathbb A^1$, and $D_i:=M\setminus B$ has special
source_lines.51: fibre $C_XY$ and ordinary fibres $Y$. It is flat over $\mathbb P^1$. The
source_lines.52: **specialization** $\sigma_i:A_m(Y)\to A_m(C_XY)$ is obtained by extending the
source_lines.53: flat pullback of a cycle to $D_i$, then taking Cartier Gysin at infinity. It
source_lines.54: sends an integral $[V]$ to the fundamental cycle $[C_{X\cap V}V]$ pushed to
source_lines.55: $C_XY$. For a regular immersion of codimension $d$, the normal cone equals the
source_lines.56: rank-$d$ normal bundle $N_{X/Y}$. The construction works for finite type
source_lines.57: schemes over a field, with locally finite cycles in the locally finite type
